notes: Hand-authored NL->SQL evaluation set for Lyntara. Gold SQL verified against the live Chinook database. Difficulty tiers follow Spider's convention: easy = single table, medium = one join or grouping, hard = multiple joins / subqueries / HAVING.

questions.question: How many albums are there?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM album;

questions.question: How many customers are from Canada?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customer WHERE country = 'Canada';

questions.question: List the names of all genres.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM genre;

questions.question: What is the duration of the longest track in milliseconds?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT max(milliseconds) FROM track;

questions.question: How many employees work for the company?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM employee;

questions.question: What is the average invoice total?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT avg(total) FROM invoice;

questions.question: List the titles of all albums by artist id 1.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT title FROM album WHERE artist_id = 1;

questions.question: How many tracks are there in each genre?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.name, count(*) FROM genre g JOIN track t ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.genre_id, g.name;

questions.question: List the names of the top 5 artists with the most albums.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ar.name FROM artist ar JOIN album al ON ar.artist_id = al.artist_id GROUP BY ar.artist_id, ar.name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 5;

questions.question: What is the total amount invoiced for each billing country?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT billing_country, sum(total) FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country;

questions.question: How many tracks does each playlist contain?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, count(*) FROM playlist p JOIN playlist_track pt ON p.playlist_id = pt.playlist_id GROUP BY p.playlist_id, p.name;

questions.question: Show the title of each album together with the name of its artist, limited to 10 rows.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT al.title, ar.name FROM album al JOIN artist ar ON al.artist_id = ar.artist_id LIMIT 10;

questions.question: Which billing countries have more than 20 invoices?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT billing_country FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country HAVING count(*) > 20;

questions.question: What are the first and last names of customers who live in Brazil?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customer WHERE country = 'Brazil';

questions.question: Which genre has the most tracks?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.name FROM genre g JOIN track t ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.genre_id, g.name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: List the full names of the top 3 customers by total amount spent.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY sum(i.total) DESC LIMIT 3;

questions.question: Which album contains the most tracks? Give the album title.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT al.title FROM album al JOIN track t ON al.album_id = t.album_id GROUP BY al.album_id, al.title ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: What is the total revenue generated from customers in the USA?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT sum(i.total) FROM invoice i JOIN customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'USA';

questions.question: Find the names of tracks that belong to the Rock genre, limited to 10.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT t.name FROM track t JOIN genre g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id WHERE g.name = 'Rock' LIMIT 10;

questions.question: How many customers does each support representative handle? Show the representative's last name.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.last_name, count(*) FROM employee e JOIN customer c ON e.employee_id = c.support_rep_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.last_name;
